caption: The drawing depicts a single clay jug placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The jug has a rounded, bulbous body and a narrow neck, widening slightly at the rim, with a single handle that attaches from the top of the neck to the jug’s shoulder. Its body is predominantly a brownish-tan color with subtle shading to indicate its three-dimensional form. Near the top of the jug, there is an inscription in blue lettering that reads "HIN/HAVINS," and blue decorative motifs, including leaves and small flower-like designs, are also present just below the neck, encircling the jug. The base of the jug is slightly darker with two blue parallel circular lines. The handle is integrated into the jug and painted in the same brownish-tan hue, with some shading for depth. There are no additional objects or background elements in the drawing.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
